description:
## X Patch 1.12.2-x.5 — native image/video long-press URL copy

All six patches can be selected together for X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01: Fix external post links; Hide Find more; Hide Who to follow; Hide sports scores (experimental); Hide search relevance prompt (experimental); Copy media URL (image/video/GIF from post options and direct image/video/GIF URL from media long-press). Existing filters are retained. The native image/video long-press action sheet gets a separate Copy media URL row without replacing built-in actions. Direct video/GIF URLs prefer the highest-bitrate MP4. The obsolete video downloader hook was removed because it does not match X 12.31.0. The presenter handler lookup was hardened for the Ahmed 1.24.2 coexistence case observed failing in x.3. Both long-press paths passed X 12.31.0 real-APK patch application; device UI and clipboard behavior require verification.
